text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, after the New Year bustle had settled down, I was having a pre-training meeting with Mejiro Ramonu...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A piece of shocking news suddenly broke in.
choice_data_list: Symboli Rudolf is stepping away from the front lines...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: Can I air the press conference?
Can I air the press conference?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Here you go.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"—The phase where I lead the pack
and pull everyone forward has concluded."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"From here on, for the future of the Umamusume world...
I intend to dedicate my all, working tirelessly both in front of and behind the scenes."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Please consider this press conference a statement of intent to demonstrate the depth of our resolve."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Still... the fans must be quite disappointed.
For an undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume to fall so soon..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"No. It is impossible for the racing world
to turn completely desolate."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I can see a new brilliance.
The brilliance of a tiara, blooming like cherry blossoms in full glory..."

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
""! Does that mean...
the first-ever Triple Tiara could actually happen!?""

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...The racing world will surely become even more vibrant going forward.
That will lead to a richer, more fulfilling world for all Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "To ensure that future is secure, we intend to provide full backing from an Umamusume's perspective, enhancing our support systems and programs."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"For all the Umamusume who will follow in our footsteps.
Here, with utmost sincerity, I declare the true beginning of the 'Emperor,' Symboli Rudolf—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Please, lend her your strength.
And together... let us build a wonderful future.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Even back then, Symboli Rudolf was already
thinking about stepping down from the front lines.
That is why...
choice_data_list: (She didn't answer when asked about facing Ramonu.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Is the meeting...
all done?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to run now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
choice_data_list: (I wonder... what Ramonu thinks about this.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's been no reaction to the press conference,
and she seems just as she always is, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!
choice_data_list: (Her running looks a little rough somehow...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I've heard about the two of them from Symboli Rudolf,
but I haven't been told what Mejiro Ramonu
herself actually thinks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Where do her true feelings lie?
I decided to ask her once more
after training finished—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It is not simply that anything will do.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When asked how she felt about Symboli Rudolf's press conference...
Her answer was remarkably nonchalant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If you refuse to enter the gate,
then it's no longer any concern of mine.
choice_data_list: But we're like comrades, aren't we?
But we're like comrades, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
How typical of Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
It'd be so much easier to just say...
she's a lover I'll never see again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I imagine so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
How can things connect
inside and outside the turf?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From those words, there is a faint trace...
of rejection. An emotion that seemed so uncharacteristic of Mejiro Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hey.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Whose Trainer
are you, exactly?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: There aren't many days left until the Oka Sho. Focus on your training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: My interest lies strictly in that—
